queries: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film), above_baseline AS (SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length, b.avg_length AS baseline_length FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ra.avg_length > b.avg_length), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM above_baseline) SELECT AVG(ab.avg_length) AS mean_rating_length, AVG(ab.avg_length - ab.baseline_length) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(ab.avg_length - km.avg_length) AS mean_above_kept_mean FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN kept_mean km WHERE ab.avg_length > km.avg_length
